description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Beetleback Chief, adding {C}{C}.
Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Beetleback Chief from your graveyard to the battlefield, and then attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Beetleback Chief triggers, creating two 1/1 Goblin tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing two Goblin tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
